groups.name: 电影感慢推镜头
groups.positive: Cinematic slow dolly-in shot, camera smoothly pushing toward the subject, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, subtle parallax between foreground and background, 24fps, natural motion blur, film grain
groups.negative: static camera, shaky cam, fast jump cuts, handheld shake, distorted perspective
groups.note: 适合人物特写与产品推进，节奏舒缓

groups.name: 赛博朋克夜景风格
groups.positive: Cyberpunk night cityscape, neon signs in pink and cyan, rain-soaked streets reflecting lights, dense fog and volumetric haze, holographic advertisements, futuristic architecture, high contrast, teal and orange color grading, ultra detailed
groups.negative: daylight, bright sun, pastel colors, low contrast, cartoon, flat lighting
groups.note: 夜景氛围基底，可与任意主体组合

groups.name: 逆光轮廓光
groups.positive: Strong backlight creating a rim light around the subject, golden hour sun low behind, lens flare, glowing edges, soft ambient fill light, volumetric god rays, cinematic lighting
groups.negative: flat front lighting, overexposed, no light source, harsh shadows on face
groups.note: 人物/物体边缘发光效果

groups.name: 航拍大远景
groups.positive: Aerial drone shot, sweeping wide establishing view, high altitude looking down, slow forward flight revealing vast landscape, smooth gimbal stabilization, epic scale, 4k
groups.negative: close-up, indoor, low angle, shaky drone footage

groups.name: 通用负向（视频）
groups.negative: blurry, low quality, jittery motion, flickering, deformed, watermark, text, logo, ugly, duplicate frames, morphing, inconsistent lighting
groups.note: 通用视频质量负向，建议常驻勾选
